title: [GMCP 203.011.03] Integration: Complete prompt and completion server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-011-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: Prompt discovery/get and argument completion implement all current schemas, roles, embedded content, pagination/filtering, list changes, cache semantics, validation, cancellation, authorization, and deterministic ranking. Prompt templates are immutable per advertised version, untrusted substitutions remain data, and injection, oversized expansion, missing argument, localization, and concurrent-update cases are proven. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
